snippet.title: singmetosleep oculus rift DK1 (2014-04-29)
snippet.description:
View in 3D: https://www.youtube.com/v/lvrH5CGRcN4 (changing the URL like this should force YouTube to use the Flash Player, which supports 3D video, instead of the default HTML5 player, which does *not* support 3D video) -- note that you'll still need to click the "gear" icon and enable 3D, and change the 3D options to your preference (cross-eyed, no glasses, etc)

Website: http://acatalept.com/singmetosleep
Playable build: http://acatalept.itch.io/singmetosleep

Oculus Rift DK1 walkthrough of prototype for atmospheric exploration narrative made with Unreal Engine 4.

Recorded at 1280x800 (native DK1 resolution), so if you have a DK1 and switch to fullscreen this should give an accurate impression.
